connection_design.HP01: Steel rail crown plus two HP03 side cheeks support cap; cap/cheek weld and rail-wall load transfer require local review.
connection_design.HP02: Bench legs weld to sole. Four spacers and four vertical bolts connect sole to cap, bypassing floor. Two longitudinal bolt rows now exist.
connection_design.panel_mounts: Seatpan four1/4inthrough-fastener candidates through BP03tabs; backpan four1/4in through candidates with BP04crush sleeves through horizontal rails. Exact small hardware/locking, dielectric isolation and torque remain to close.
connection_design.floor_closeout: Do not clamp floor beneath sole. Proposed removable flexible nonstructural skirt/boot; material, flame performance, fasteners and edge reinforcement not yet defined.

proposed_workmanship.tube_cuts: Cutlength +/-1/32in, squarewithin0.5degree trialtargets; deburr. Weld fixture foot coplanarity target0.5mm before matched spacer fitting. Targets are designer proposals to validate with shop process.
proposed_workmanship.plates: Profile +/-1/32in; coordinated hole positions +/-1/64in from common datum; drill/finish Ø9/16 +1/64/-0 proposed. Final bolt slip/fatigue design may tighten these values.
proposed_workmanship.spacers: Finish matched footsets to measured welded stack; length trialtarget +/-0.05mm, within-set difference<=0.05mm. Do not stack loose washers to adjust floor gap.
proposed_workmanship.welds: Initial trials:1/8in E70 fillet on bench tube/sole and tube/tube connections;3/16in E70 cap/cheek attachment. These are proposed process inputs, not accepted effective weld lengths or capacities. Rounded HSS faces require actual fit-up and qualified procedure; do not assume sharp-box perimeter contact.
proposed_workmanship.inspection: Record material heat/grade, cut dimensions, holes, assembled diagonals, weld process/visual results, spacer lengths, floor gaps under test, bolt grip/thread engagement and positive retention. Record actual findings; no test result claimed.

responsibilities.farm_or_Ralph: Inventory, marked cutting, noncritical jigs, trial fit and assembly only to demonstrated capability and later released details. No assumed welding qualification.
responsibilities.subcontract: Precision spacers/sleeves, coordinated drilling/reaming where required, critical weld procedure/fabrication/inspection, coatings and upholstery/finish work per owner outsourcing direction.
responsibilities.engineering: Accept load cases and applicability, joint stiffness/prying/contact, wall/fatigue checks, wholevehicle mass/CG, comfort/egress and prototype test acceptance.
